metadata.title: Wholesale Ordering and Reference Load Planning | YolPol
metadata.description: Learn how wholesale ordering, loading and buyer-arranged transportation work, with reference pallet planning for glass packaging.

ExportLogistics.heading: Wholesale Process
ExportLogistics.introduction: Learn how wholesale ordering, loading and buyer-arranged transportation work.

capacity.heading: Reference load planning
capacity.text: A standard-trailer reference configuration uses 26 pallets and an approximate 26,000 kg planning envelope. Actual vehicle and legal limits may vary.

method.heading: How calculation works
method.text: Enter whole pallets only. Packages, bottles and gross weight are calculated from verified Product profiles for reference planning.

calculator.heading: Pallet load calculator
calculator.bothExceeded: Reference pallet count and gross-weight envelope exceeded
calculator.disclaimer: This calculation is for a 26-pallet reference load only; it is not a freight quotation, carrier acceptance, customs guarantee or delivery promise. Actual vehicle capacity and legal, axle, road, carrier, customs and border limits may vary. Transportation is arranged by the buyer.
calculator.insufficientData: Verified packaging data is unavailable for a selected Product.
calculator.arithmeticOverflow: The load is too large to calculate safely.

unavailable.heading: Products unavailable for calculation
unavailable.text: These Products lack a verified packaging profile, so no values are estimated.

steps.1: The buyer discovers and selects products.
steps.2: The buyer submits a wholesale inquiry.
steps.3: Product specifications, quantity and commercial terms are discussed and confirmed.
steps.4: The buyer arranges the vehicle and transportation.
steps.5: The buyer-arranged vehicle arrives at the loading location.
steps.6: The buyer or driver representative may inspect the prepared load where applicable.
steps.8: Payment or other approved commercial terms are completed according to the agreed arrangement before cargo release.
steps.10: Onward transportation remains the buyer's responsibility.

limitations.heading: Planning limitations
limitations.text: The calculator is a commercial planning reference, not carrier booking, a freight quotation, a legal transport document, a customs guarantee or a delivery promise.
